exposure: Monochorionic twins with at least one arterioarterial anastomosis
Presence or absence of placental anastomoses
Presence or absence of at least one arterioarterial anastomosis
Presence and type of placental anastomoses
finding: Vascular anastomoses were found to have a significant impact on the intrauterine growth of monochorionic twins, with the absence of anastomoses being associated with higher birthweight differences and discordance, while the presence of arterioarterial anastomoses was associated with similar birthweights despite higher placental territory sharing discordance.
